name: License Audit
shortDescription: Audits npm project dependencies for license compatibility, flagging GPL/AGPL conflicts and generating compliance reports.

rawRecord.name: License Audit
rawRecord.short_description: Audits npm project dependencies for license compatibility, flagging GPL/AGPL conflicts and generating compliance reports.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: License Audit reads a project's package.json dependencies, fetches each package's license from the npm registry, and categorizes them as permissive, copyleft, or weak-copyleft. It flags incompatibilities between the project's own license and its dependencies — such as GPL dependencies in MIT-licensed projects — assigning risk levels (low, medium, high) and producing a structured compliance report.
